Chapter 307 - 307 Super Smart Watch; Name Change!

Chapter 307 - 307 Super Smart Watch; Name Change!

307 Super Smart Watch; Name Change!

After Lin Fan was done here, he went to the library.

The library of Jiangbei University was always packed with people.

Lin Fan walked past the language category, mathematics category, geography category… He went straight to the chemistry bookshelf.

He had to admit that Jiangbei University had a very comprehensive collection of books.

Lin Fan spent a few minutes to find the five books he needed—Battery Principles, Battery Handbook, Lithium-ion Batteries, Polymer Batteries, and Battery Structure and Principles.

He hugged the five thick books and glanced at the seats filled with people in the distance.

At this moment, a familiar voice sounded behind him.

“I have an available seat there. Do you want it?”

When Lin Fan heard that, he slowly turned around.

A fair woman with exquisite facial features appeared in front of him. She was wearing a long dress and black-rimmed glasses. She looked very beautiful and quiet.

She was Lu Ling, whom he had seen several times in the library.

Lin Fan remembered that she was a physics major.

He seemed to meet her every time he came to the library. Was this fate?

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and said, “Yeah, I do.”

Then, under Lu Ling’s lead, Lin Fan came to the seat that he had sat on several times.

He could not help but wonder and asked, “Do you always sit here?”

“Can’t I?” Lu Ling asked.

“Of course, you can.” Lin Fan shrugged.

Lin Fan did not continue chatting. Instead, he used his scanning ability and quickly flipped through Battery Principles which was in his hands.

The sound of someone flipping through a book immediately rang out.

Battery Principles was hundreds of pages long. However, Lin Fan only spent five minutes to memorize all the contents.

Then, he moved on to Battery Handbook.

The third book was Lithium-Ion Batteries.

Instantly, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Mission completed: Watch a battery experiment (1/1). Read Battery Principles, Battery Handbook, Lithium-ion Batteries, Polymer Batteries, and Battery Structure and Principles (5/5). You’ve obtained a super battery patent, as well as the manufacturing principle and complete thesis.]

In an instant, other than the five books on battery knowledge that he had just flipped through, there was a tsunami of battery knowledge in Lin Fan’s mind.

Lu Ling saw that Lin Fan was not flipping through books anymore and asked, “Batteries? Are you studying chemistry now?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

Then, he looked down at the questions on Lu Ling’s desk and said, “You don’t know this question anymore?”

Lu Ling opened her mouth. She really wanted to say again?

Alright, it was indeed again.

She really wouldn’t.

Lin Fan could easily read her thoughts from her expression.

At this moment, Lin Fan had just completed his mission and was in a good mood.

Hence, he picked up his pen and easily answered the questions on it.

After reading it, Lu Ling’s pretty face revealed a touch of realization.

Lin Fan smiled and strode toward the exit of the library.

Lu Ling hesitated for a moment and said, “Please wait a moment. Thank you for helping me answer the questions. I’ll treat you to lunch.”

At the mention of food, Lin Fan’s stomach was indeed a little hungry.

Therefore, he immediately replied, “Okay.”

Lu Ling tidied up the books on the table and went to the cafeteria with Lin Fan.

Originally, Lu Ling wanted to treat Lin Fan to expensive food.

However, no matter how expensive it was, could it be as expensive as what Lin Fan usually ate?

Lin Fan rejected her right away.

Sea cucumbers, abalones, and other such foods… Sometimes, he would get sick of them too.

It was also a good choice to occasionally eat the food in the cafeteria for a change.

At this time, it was mealtime.

There were many people in the cafeteria. After ordering some food, Lu Ling and Lin Fan found an empty seat and sat down.

Lu Ling took a few mouthfuls of rice and could not help but say, “Lin Fan, why are you so good at math? Is it because of interest?”

“I’m not interested in mathematics,” said Lin Fan.

Lin Fan was not lying.

The reason why he entered Jiangbei University was to experience life.

As for those difficult questions, it was entirely because it was convenient for him to do so, as well as because they were missions given by the system.

“huh?” Lu Ling was stunned for a moment. “Then… Then how did you solve so many difficult problems?”

Obviously, after Lin Fan introduced himself last time, Lu Ling already knew his identity.

“Those problems?” Lin Fan asked. “Aren’t you able to answer them by looking at them?”

He was able to answer them just by looking?

Including Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, Hail Conjecture, and Hodge Conjecture?

These… They were all world-class math problems!

Lu Ling was completely stunned.

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket vibrated.

12:00 PM!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 18,888 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a super smart watch.]

This time, Lin Fan received a total of 53,211 yuan.

Lin Fan did not even want to look at this bit of money.

He immediately focused his gaze on… the black watch on his wrist that suddenly appeared.

A super smart watch!

“I suddenly remembered something important…I’ll be leaving first.” After Lin Fan finished speaking, he walked out.

He really wanted to see what this super smart watch was.

Lin Fan had a strong feeling that this was definitely a good treasure!

Lu Ling was left alone in the cafeteria with a blank face.

Lin Fan did not go to the dormitory. Instead, he went to the Mercedes-Benz and headed toward the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He sped all the way there.

About 20 minutes later, Lin Fan arrived at the sofa in the Coiling Dragon Villa and sat down.

Then, he turned his attention back to the super smart watch.

[Super Smart Watch: An AI watch that combines protection, calculation, tracking, and other powerful abilities into one. It’s absolutely loyal to its owner and helps its owner easily complete things, displaying extraordinary power.]

An AI watch that combined powerful abilities such as defense, calculation, and tracking?

For some reason, Lin Fan suddenly thought of Jarvis in Iron Man.

Lin Fan’s heart raced as he asked, “A super smart watch?”

“I’m here, Master. What can I do for you?” The watch screen lit up slightly and emitted a magnetic sound.

Even though Lin Fan had heard many beautiful voices before, he was still a little weak at this moment.

After a while, Lin Fan asked, “Do you have a name?”

“Super Smart Watch.”

“This name… doesn’t sound good. I’ll change it to a better name. You’re all black, so you’ll be called… Lil White, then,” Lin Fan said.

“Ding! The modification was successful. Lil White Then is at your service.”

Lin Fan was speechless.

Was this really a super smart watch?

Not a super silly watch?

Was he expecting too much from it?
